TaskDescription: Kinesthetic motor imagery (MI) of grasping with the dominant hand versus rest/idle. Five runs per subject: RUN0 is a real grasping movement used to introduce the protocol; RUN1-RUN4 are MI vs Rest only. EMG of the dominant hand was acquired for protocol control.
InstitutionName: PROMAB Lab. IMAL - CONICET. Santa Fe. Argentina.
